lines.text: David says that if the LORD stays silent, he will be like sheep without a shepherd.
David lifts his hands toward the LORD's holy sanctuary and asks not to be dragged away with the wicked.
David asks the LORD to repay the wicked for their deeds, and He will tear them down for good.
David blesses the LORD for hearing his cry for mercy and calls Him his strength and shield.
The LORD is the strength of His priests, and David asks Him to bless His inheritance and carry them forever.
